Name: ENEMY_COMMON_PARAM_ST
Description: Global enemy AI settings: how long enemies chase sound, search and memory targets, the phantom shader for time-of-day spawns, and the unreachable-target check at path ends. Only row 0 is used.

Fields.Name: Sound Target - Approach Time Limit
Fields.Description: Seconds an enemy keeps going to a heard sound before giving up. After this time runs out, the sound target's own memory time starts counting down, and the target is forgotten when that reaches 0. Retail: 30.

Fields.Name: Search Target - Approach Time Limit
Fields.Description: Seconds an enemy keeps going to a search target before giving up. After this time runs out, the search target's own memory time starts counting down, and the target is forgotten when that reaches 0. Retail: 30.

Fields.Name: Memory Target - Approach Time Limit
Fields.Description: Seconds an enemy keeps going to a remembered target position before giving up. After this time runs out, the memory target's own memory time starts counting down, and the target is forgotten when that reaches 0. Retail: 30.

Fields.Name: Time-of-Day Spawn - Fade Phantom ID
Fields.Description: PhantomParam row used as the shader while enemies that only exist at certain times of day fade in or out. Retail: 40.

Fields.Name: Unreachable Path End - Horizontal Distance
Fields.Description: Metres. The end of an enemy's path counts as a failed approach when the target is within this horizontal distance of the path's last point and at least Unreachable Path End - Height above it (plus a steepness check). Retail: 10.

Fields.Name: Unreachable Path End - Height
Fields.Description: Metres. How far above the path's last point the target must be for the path end to count as a failed approach (see Unreachable Path End - Horizontal Distance). Retail: 3.
